text:
Sam: hey team — quick question about org ownership and escalation for Dedicated/private requests. If I need Dedicated GPU access for a POC or want to request a model rollout, who owns approvals vs who does infra changes? Also who do I escalate to if the Dedicated pool is flapping? first week so apologies if this is in docs.

Maya: welcome Sam! :wave: High level: infra owns the Dedicated pools and config, product/your manager owns business sign-off for rollouts. For access requests ping #eng-infra and cc your manager. For private/VPC/KMS security sign-off we loop in security.

Devon: infra here — we own capacity, autoscaling policies, and pool configs. For requests open an INFRA-ACCESS ticket (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/INFRA-ACCESS) and tag me. Include desired GPU type, expected QPS, and whether you need burst capacity. If the pool is unstable, page eng-oncall first (channel: #eng-oncall).

Lina-sec: lina-sec: quick note on data classification — if your model will handle sensitive customer data or KMS usage, file a security review with the template in /security/reviews. For regular Dedicated workloads we do a lightweight ack; Private deployments need a full review. DM me if unsure.

Ash: ash: onboarding checklist snippet — use this request body for the Jira: 
```
jira: INFRA-ACCESS
assignee: devon
summary: Dedicated pool request - <project-name>
labels: onboarding, dedicated
fields: { gpu_type: a100, qps_estimate: 200 }
```
Also add expected timeline and a manager approver. We have a short template under /docs/onboarding/dedicated-requests if you want me to paste it.

Sam: thanks, very helpful. For escalation timing: if eng-oncall doesn't respond, when do we escalate to infra leads or SRE?

Maya: maya: if it's impacting production: page eng-oncall -> wait 10-15m -> escalate to infra oncall lead (see #eng-sre pinned escalation list) -> ping your manager + me. For customer-impacting incidents we follow the incident runbook in /incidents/runbook.

Devon: devon: agreed. Also add: if it's during your POC and not customer-facing, tag #eng-infra and we'll triage with lower priority but still aim for same-day response. For urgent drop-in outages use the PD rota (pager).

onboard-bot: onboard-bot: Heads up: new hires, run `setup-check` and fill the Access Request template within your first week to avoid delays. :memo:

Sam: sam: awesome, will open the INFRA-ACCESS ticket now and follow the template. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
